description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real household survey data with two variables: 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure in dollars) and 'income' (weekly income in $100 units) for 40 households.

Create a scatter plot with 'income' on the x-axis and 'food_exp' on the y-axis. Use the menu: View > Graph specified vars > X-Y scatter. In the dialog, select 'income' as the X variable and 'food_exp' as the Y variable, then click OK. When the graph appears, save it as a PNG file to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/food_scatter.png using File > Save as (PNG format) in the graph window.

metadata.data_source: Hill, Griffiths, Lim - Principles of Econometrics 5th ed, household survey data
